desc: Advanced Privacy Browser Core with Unified Fingerprint Defense: Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada, Shape, DataDome, PerimeterX, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, Imperva, reCAPTCHA, ThreatMetrix, Adscore
